$comment: Keiko Editor bundle-size budget (Issue #1207; ADR-0042 D3.6). Enforced deterministically by scripts/editor-bundle-size.mjs, which runs standalone (`npm run check:editor-bundle-size`) and inside `check:package-surface` (the `ci` prepack chain). PR CI for feat/keiko-editor also runs it after `npm run build:ui` with `--require-static-export` so initial static-export JS is scanned. The 2.5 MB-gzip lazy editor + Monaco runtime budget and the <=750 KB-gzip per-worker-chunk budget are measured against the real production bundle as release evidence by #1209; this file enforces the parts that regress in this repo deterministically: the editor package's own compiled footprint, the pinned Monaco version the runtime footprint was measured against, and the first-load code-split isolation (Monaco/editor runtime value-imported only behind a client-only dynamic boundary). The editor own-code ceiling is rebased from 96 KiB to 100 KiB for the current Monaco 0.55.1 multi-language editor dist (100629 B across 71 files after a clean @oscharko-dev/keiko-editor build), preserving ~1.7 KiB margin while still catching accidental heavy dependency or Monaco bundling. The 320 KiB initial-page ceiling records the rebased #2055 + #1982 desktop baseline, rebased for Epic #2238 (governed Atlassian connector UI), rebased again (315392 -> 323584, +8 KiB) for the PR #2315 i18n retrofit of six previously-uncovered Quality/Files widgets (AgentRunWidget, FilePreview, FilesWidget, PdfCitationPreviewWindow, ReviewWidget, FigmaSnapshotWindow), rebased again (323584 -> 327680, +4 KiB) for the PR #2306 SonarCloud S3776 cleanup on top of that i18n retrofit, and rebased again (327680 -> 331776, +4 KiB) for PR #2471's merge of dev's #2469 Coding Workbench governance feature (CodingWorkbenchQuestions/Sections/Window plus its own eagerly-loaded EN/DE i18n catalogs, all first-load desktop-shell surface) on top of #2471's own SonarCloud RELIABILITY remediation (a handful of terser regex one-liners in AppShell.tsx replaced with slightly larger, S8786-safe manual-scan helpers). CI/Linux measured 327686 B at the merged HEAD, confirmed in an isolated Linux container build (not just CI); the new ceiling keeps the same ~4 KiB margin as the prior rebase. CI/Linux remains the authoritative static-export measurement. See docs/keiko-editor/1207-performance-budgets.md.
